texts.zh:
[Planet.GetName]最初被评定为典型的岩浆烈焰星球，然而调查发现，在行星表面纵横交错的裂谷中，存在复杂的本地植物生态系统。这些植物能够产生氧气并收集少有的水分，在炽热的荒原之中形成近乎温带的微气候区域。

这一生态系统为原本无法在火山星球上生存的物种创造出适合栖息的环境，植被本身也可能适宜农业开发。建议定居者深入峡谷，对其中的生物进行详尽探索。
texts.en:
Initial assessment of [Planet.GetName] characterized it as a world of magma and fire, but surveys have revealed a native ecosystem of complex flora inhabiting a network of rift valleys across the planet. These plants produce oxygen and collect what little moisture exists, resulting in pockets of almost temperate microclimates in an otherwise superheated wasteland.

The biomes supported by this flora could prove habitable for species that otherwise avoid settling volcanic worlds, and the flora itself may be suitable for agriculture. It would benefit any settlers to thoroughly explore what exactly lives in those canyons.
